rationale: Fresh implementation validation passes for TASK-045. Source refs show the task is self-contained and backed by accepted planning proof. Code review confirms the compact Pi diff panel now reads through a focused decision approval model, shows current/desired state, affected layers, risk, alternatives, and build eligibility, and invokes CodeWiki diff-table actions for approve/reject/defer/edit rather than hand-editing canonical decision build state. The new task-candidate approval model presents task/sprint candidates and explicit typed fallback before codewiki_task mutation. Tests cover approve, reject, defer, edit, approved-only build eligibility, fallback instructions, task candidate presentation, and existing control-room/efficiency UI behavior. Non-goals are preserved: no bypass of codewiki_diff_table/codewiki_task, no removal of fallback, and no agency runner/scheduler UI logic.
